status: Artist collection contract; pending architect promotion

profile.meaning: Wall-axis endpoint plus an inset walking-lane center at the standard datum.

matching: Same profile and coincident wall-axis endpoints
Coincident walkway centers, widths and standard heights
Clearance volumes and reserved physical bounds fit the chosen neighbors
placement: 3 m perimeter grid; .5 m authored footprint subdivisions; exact unit instance scale.

stair.note: Upper side exits use the explicit extended landing and omit the guard on the connected side.

frontendSpecific.gateOpening: Main gate rough aperture 4 × 4.12 m; frame and fittings reduce the fully open envelope. See each portal record.

futureReuse: Roles, metre origins, quarter turns, native attachment datums, named pivots, clearances and matching rules can be reused by later castle or chain-link collections.
futureChanges: Different wall thicknesses, panels, posts, corners, towers, walk widths, gates and stairs require their own geometry and explicit transition adapters. Material replacement alone does not prove compatibility.
unsupported: Mixing unequal walkway heights/offsets without a transition
Plugging a U return directly into a collinear straight-run socket
Automatic collision, navigation, ballistics, structural or fire support
